title: Crafted Anew
description: Adds a variety of new enchantments, QOL features, and reworks to existing enchantments and items.
body:
# The Recrafted

## Items

### Beetroot Soup
beetroot soup can now be crafted with any amount of beetroots, with more beetroots providing more nutrition bars but taking longer to eat.

### Cake
Crafted cakes can now be eaten without being place down taking much longer to eat than other foods.

### Smelting
- Smelting armors and tools will now give you an ingot instead of a nugget. 
- Smelting blocks is now possible at a less efficient rate.
- Smelting cobblestone into stone is now possible in a blast furnace.

### Shields
Iron Shields now have reduced durability. (336 -> 125)

## Enchantments

### Aqua Affinity 
Aqua Affinity has 2 levels now. Level 1 provides slightly less. (+400% -> +300%) Level 2 provides even faster mining than above water. (+450%)

### Bane of Arthropods 
Bane of arthropods now works on any entity with the "Infested" Effect.

### Feather Falling 
Feather falling provides less fall damage protection. (3 -> 2 per level) But now gives safe fall distance. (+2 per level)

### Frost Walker 
Frost walker 2 now gives a large enough range to sprint-jump

### Impaling 
Impaling now works like it does on bedrock. Dealing extra damage to any entity in water, with a slight nerf on damage. (+12.5 -> +7.5 max level)

### Mending 
Mending gives less durability per level. (2 -> 0.5)

### Projectile Protection 
Projectile protection provides more protection from projectiles. (2 -> 3 per level)

### Smite 
Smite now Gives weakness 2 to undead.

# The Crafted Anew

## Items

### Shields
Diamond and netherite shields can now be crafted with much more durability.
- Diamond - 731
- Netherite - 1016

## Enchantments

### Cleaving III
An enchantment for the axe, provides equal damage to sharpness as well as giving 10% armor reduction.
- Mutually exclusive with sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, life steal, illager's bane, and rampage

### Cowardice IV
Leggings enchantment, gives speed after being attacked.
- Mutually exclusive with Thorns

### Curse of Fragility
halves the durability of an item.
- mutually exclusive with unbreaking

### Curse of Fatigue
halves the players mining speed when equiped.
- mutually exclusive with efficiency

### Guarding
Enchantment for Shields, Provides massive damage reduction while sneaking.

### Illager's Bane V
Weapon enchant that deals more damage to these mobs:
- Pillager
- Vindicator
- Ravager
- Witch
- Evoker
- Illusioner
 
- Mutually exclusive with sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, life steal, cleaving, and rampage

### Life Steal III
weapon enchant, provides slight healing upon attack.
- mutually exclusive with sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, cleaving, illager's bane, and rampage

### Keeping IV
Armor enchant that gives more xp from mobs.

### Paralizing III
Enchantment for the mace, with higher falls provides higher weakness and slowness effects.

### Rampage II
Axe enchantment that gives strength for a brief duration after every attack.
- mutually exclusive with sharpness, smite, bane of arthropods, cleaving, illager's bane, and life steal

### Recycling III
Crossbow enchantment, provides a chance to not consume an arrow
- mutually exclusive with piercing, multishot, and sharpshooter

### Sharpshooter V
Crossbow enchant that gives higher damage, but a slower charge rate.
- mutually exclusive with piercing, multishot, and recycling
